data.body: Closed leaf `strange-urological-cornsnake` (`8455-598a-8245-4f4b`). Gerrit 2737 merged as `240f740ad77b109d0bc596ae09dc4fab69b7380c` after `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved comments (CI run 34083756078: PASS, 22 jobs, no retry). The final close blocker was a literal `\\n` before AC3's `provenance:` continuation; corrected only that tracker text, then obtained one fresh plan-review PASS and one completion-verifier PASS at the landed SHA. The shared MCP checkout could not see the referencing commit from its current HEAD, so the ordinary unforced close was routed through a short-lived worktree-rooted MCP server at the landed commit. Shared MCP now reports status `closed`; completion signature is verified/certified at `240f740...`. Future leaves remain comments/documentation-only and will use scoped local checks plus Gerrit CI, per operator direction; no further full local suite is planned.
